item.title: Epic boss Tim Sweeney confirms Fortnite will not release on iOS in Japan due to Apple's alleged "obstruction and lawbreaking"
item.description: Fortnite will not be returning to iOS in Japan next year "as promised" because, according to Epic Games boss Tim Sweeney, Apple has allegedly launched "another travesty of obstruction and lawbreaking". Read more

item.title: New report claims Xbox Wrapped 2025 isn't happening this year due to marketing budget constraints
item.description: While every site you've ever visited in 2025 seems intent on summarising your year even for things you absolutely don't need to be summarised (the cards I completed in Asana this year? Uh, no thanks), there's one wrapped message you probably won't be getting this year: Xbox. Read more

item.title: Indie Game Awards disqualifies Game of the Year winner Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 for using AI
item.description: The Indie Game Awards has withdrawn two awards previously given to Clair Obscur: Expedition 33, not because of the debate about what does and doesn't constitute an "indie" game, but because a representative of Sandfall Interactive had agreed that no gen AI had been used in the development when, in fact, it had. Read more

item.title: Here's Hideo Kojima interviewing himself, and interviewing Stranger Things' creators, the Duffer Brothers (but not at the same time)
item.description: Hideo Kojima has popped up on Wired's (fantastic) Tech Support series (did you know that we're closer in time to Cleopatra than Cleopatra is to the beginning of ancient Egypt?) answering questions about – well, himself, in the main. Read more

item.title: The Beloved Octopath Traveler series surpasses 6m lifetime sales, shortly after Octopath Traveler 0's launch
item.description: Square Enix has announced the Octopath Traveller series has surpassed 6m lifetime sales, shortly after the release of Octopath Traveller 0. Read more

item.title: "Passionate response" to Tomb Raider 2013's Switch port could mean Rise and Shadow also come to Nintendo's consoles
item.description: The rebooted 2013 Tomb Raider made its Switch debut just a matter of weeks ago, and thanks to the "passionate response" from the community, port developer Aspyr may now consider bringing the trilogy's final two entries to Nintendo's platform as well. Read more

item.title: Expert in KOTOR 2 Switch lawsuit argued that the fan-made mod entire DLC was based on had "no economic value"
item.description: New details have been revealed regarding the Knights of the Old Republic 2 false advertisement lawsuit for Switch consoles. This includes an argument made by one expert brought in by Aspyr who stated that the fan-made Restored Content mod the missing DLC was based on had "no economic value". Read more

item.title: Clair Obscur's Gustave motion performer argues game awards should have a Best Character category, rather than "isolating a single performer and potentially leaving others invisible"
item.description: Since Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 released, there has been much discussion about the game's performances. While all are exemplary, and saw the likes of Jennifer English and Ben Starr receive nominations for Best Performer at this year's The Game Awards, there has since been debate over what exactly it means to be nominated in this category. Read more

item.title: "Is it okay for video games to be this good?" - developers tell us their favourite games of the year
item.description: Before we tell you what we think, and before we reveal what you think, we thought we'd do something a little bit different as part of our usual end-of-year games-of-the-year celebrations. What, we wondered, do the people who actually make the games think? As so we've chatted with the developers behind some of our favourite 2025 releases to find out which new games have resonated most with them as the year has gone on. Read more

item.title: Cronos: The New Dawn too hard for you? An easy mode is finally on the way
item.description: Time-travelling psychological horror game Cronos: The New Dawn is finally getting an additional, easier difficulty mode for people who want less of a gameplay challenge. Read more
